$comment: Stale-term rules for scripts/check-docs.mjs. A rule is { id, pattern, flags?, message, allow?, severity? }; allow lists files (globs: * within a folder, ** across folders) that may keep the term on purpose. A line ending in 'em-dash: intended' is skipped by every rule.

rules.message: The package is the unscoped `ooxml-core` now.
The package is the unscoped `ooxml-ui` now.
There is no `pptx-viewer` checkout to enter; the viewer lives in `viewers/pptx` of this repository.
Viewers are workspace members; do not advise `file:../` links to a sibling checkout.
The viewers live in `viewers/<product>` of this repository, not in a separate repository.
No em-dashes in docs (AGENTS.md style rule); use a colon, comma, semicolon, parentheses or a spaced hyphen.

$generatedRoutesComment: Site-absolute routes the docs build generates (framework demos copied in by the Pages build, per-package release pages written by sync-changelogs.mjs); they are not tracked files.
$pathIgnoreComment: Inline-code paths not checked: files that record history on purpose, and output folders of a build (suite-dist/apps/word).
$translationScopeComment: Per docs site and locale, the English pages (globs relative to the docs root) a locale is meant to cover. Missing pages outside the scope are not counted; translations that exist are always checked for lag. Without an entry a locale is expected to cover every page, and missing pages are still informational only.
$lagIgnoreCommitsComment: Changes to an English page that its translations do not need (table re-padding, or fixes the translations already had), so they do not make the translations count as older. Like a blame ignore list: full commit hashes, each with the files it applies to.
